_comment: SG13CMOS5L PDK pin fact sheet. TWO pins appear here and must not be conflated: (1) the TARGET/SETUP pin (top-level source/branch/pinned_commit/tarball_url/tarball_sha256/subtree), re-stamped per issue #322 to match the upstream fetch script 2AMLogic/klayout-tools scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13cmos5l.sh (klayout-tools#2720) -- this is what a fresh environment should install, and NO sim/sg13cmos5l-*/ record has been generated with it; (2) the HISTORICAL pin ('historical_pin_used_by_existing_evidence' below, the archived standalone IHP-GmbH/ihp-sg13cmos5l main @ 607e18d4) that every existing sim/sg13cmos5l-*/ record was actually generated against. Existing records stay traceable to the historical pin; refreshing them on the target pin is the deferred scope of #322. The remainder of this comment is the original (pre-#322) rationale, written when the standalone repo was the only source: a NEW file, not a restructuring of sim/pdk.json (issue #65's Builder's-call decision): sim/pdk.json's own schema (release_tag + tarball_sha256) assumes a tagged tarball release, which is how IHP-Open-PDK/SG13G2 ships (see sim/pdk.json), but SG13CMOS5L (as of this pin) ships only as a live 'main'-branch git checkout with no tags/releases at all -- forcing that schema onto a git-commit pin would either lie (fabricate a fake tarball_sha256) or require reshaping the schema for both PDKs at once, more churn than this phase's scope needs. A restructured, PDK-keyed sim/pdk.json remains an option for a future phase if a third PDK variant lands and the two schemas converge; not done here to keep this phase's footprint to 'add a CMOS5L fact sheet', matching design/sg13cmos5l/README.md's own choice to add a new subdirectory rather than restructure design/'s existing SG13G2 layout. Every record under sim/sg13cmos5l-*/records/*.md must trace to this file (or a later commit that bumps it; records that predate the #322 re-stamp trace to the historical pin) -- see sim/README.md 'PDK pin, per variant' section.
target_pin_status: TARGET/SETUP pin only (issue #322, documentation re-stamp). Stamped to agree with the upstream fetch script's IHP_SG13CMOS5L_COMMIT / IHP_SG13CMOS5L_URL / IHP_SG13CMOS5L_SHA256 (consistency check against the script text read via the GitHub API; the tarball was NOT downloaded or independently hashed for this change). No simulation, model build or model load has been run against this pin: runtime compatibility is UNVERIFIED. No sim/sg13cmos5l-*/ record was generated with it.
fetch_method: Preferred: reuse klayout-tools' scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13cmos5l.sh (checksum-pinned, fails closed on mismatch), which extracts only the ihp-sg13cmos5l/ subtree of the pinned commit's codeload tarball as pdks/ihp-open-pdk/ihp-sg13cmos5l/, a sibling of the ihp-sg13g2/ checkout produced by scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh (run that first; the CMOS5L fetch refuses to run without the sibling). No IHP-Open-PDK release includes SG13CMOS5L yet (latest, v0.3.0, predates the merge), so the pin is a dev-branch commit SHA plus the tarball sha256. The standalone IHP-GmbH/ihp-sg13cmos5l repository was archived upstream on 2026-09-23 (klayout-tools#2720) and is no longer the target source.
upstream_context_unmeasured: rf[n|p]mos_minW is reported as 0.39 um at the new pin (issue #322). design/sg13cmos5l and layout/common_sg13cmos5l.py contain no rfnmos/rfpmos references, so any effect on this repo's benches is unmeasured and none is claimed.

historical_pin_used_by_existing_evidence._comment: Provenance of ALL existing sim/sg13cmos5l-*/ records (generated 2026-08, before the upstream re-point). Retained verbatim as history; do not read these values as the current setup target.
historical_pin_used_by_existing_evidence.fetch_method: git clone https://github.com/IHP-GmbH/ihp-sg13cmos5l.git -- no tagged release existed (repo README: 'meant to be used only as a temporary storage during the development of the build/compile migration script'); a commit on the 'main' branch was pinned, not a checksummed tarball. Commit reachability was re-verified with `git merge-base --is-ancestor <pinned_commit> main` rather than assuming tag-style immutability. This repository has since been archived upstream.

pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13cmos5l (open_pdks-shaped install, klt pdk find/list convention; with the upstream fetch script PDK_ROOT is pdks/ihp-open-pdk and the subtree arrives as a sibling of ihp-sg13g2/) -- same PDK_ROOT sim/pdk.json's ihp-sg13g2 install already resolves from, see 'sibling_checkout_requirement' below for why both must coexist under one PDK_ROOT.
relationship_to_ihp_sg13g2: SG13CMOS5L is IHP's reduced-metal-stack CMOS-only sibling process to SG13G2, not an unrelated third PDK -- confirmed directly from the installed checkout (see spec/porting-plan-sg13cmos5l.md section 1). Front-end devices this repo's schematics use (sg13_hv_pmos/nmos, pnpMPA, rppd/rhigh) are the SAME models as SG13G2's: sg13cmos5l_pr's .sym files and this PDK's own libs.tech/ngspice/models/*.lib corner files for those devices (cornerMOShv.lib, cornerRES.lib, sg13g2_moshv_mod.lib, etc. -- note the literal sg13g2_*.lib filenames even under the ihp-sg13cmos5l tree) are relative SYMLINKS into a sibling ihp-sg13g2 checkout, not independent copies.

sibling_checkout_requirement._comment: A real, upstream-worthy PDK-tooling gap, filed per CLAUDE.md's friction protocol at 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#1406 (design/sg13cmos5l/README.md 'Tooling/PDK friction encountered' has the full account from issue #64/#68's own discovery of the xschem-symbol half of this same gap). This sim/ phase (#65) hit the SAME dangling-symlink pattern independently for the ngspice corner-lib files (cornerMOShv.lib, cornerRES.lib, sg13g2_moshv_mod.lib, etc. under libs.tech/ngspice/models/), not just the xschem symbols #1406 already covers -- same root cause (an ihp-sg13cmos5l-only install has no sibling ihp-sg13g2/ to resolve the relative symlink target against), different file class. Not re-filed as a second issue: #1406's own description already generalizes to 'this PDK's install-shape assumption is a combined checkout', which covers both file classes.
sibling_checkout_requirement.requirement: PDK_ROOT must contain BOTH ihp-sg13g2/ and ihp-sg13cmos5l/ side by side (historical note: the archived standalone repo's README documented this shape as 'git clone --branch dev --recurse-submodules https://github.com/IHP-GmbH/IHP-Open-PDK.git; cd IHP-Open-PDK; git clone https://github.com/IHP-GmbH/ihp-sg13cmos5l.git'; at the target pin the subtree ships inside IHP-Open-PDK itself and the upstream fetch script requires the ihp-sg13g2/ sibling to already exist). An ihp-sg13cmos5l-only install leaves every shared-device symlink dangling and every sim/sg13cmos5l-*/ testbench in this tree unrunnable.
sibling_checkout_requirement.how_this_repo_resolved_it_in_this_enviro: HISTORICAL (old pin, 2026-08): fetched IHP-Open-PDK v0.3.0's tarball (the same release + sha256 sim/pdk.json already pins for the SG13G2-only tree) and extracted only its ihp-sg13g2/ subtree as a sibling of the existing ihp-sg13cmos5l/ checkout under the shared PDK_ROOT -- no design/xschemrc or sim/env.sh change needed or made, since both already resolve PDK_ROOT/PDK generically from the environment. This is an environment-setup step, not a repo change; a fresh environment needs the ihp-sg13g2/ sibling next to ihp-sg13cmos5l/ (planned route: run klayout-tools scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh, then scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13cmos5l.sh) before any sim/sg13cmos5l-*/ testbench can run. Which SG13G2 sibling is compatible with the target CMOS5L pin is not yet identified or verified.

osdi_toolchain._comment: Rewritten for issue #322. At the TARGET pin the setup requires BUILDING OSDI models from Verilog-A source; the earlier 'prebuilt .osdi binaries, no build step' assertion applied only to the old standalone-repo pin and is retained below as dated history. Upstream removed the prebuilt x86-64 cap_cmomi.osdi / cap_cmomf.osdi at/after IHP-Open-PDK dev commit e8fba183 (IHP-Open-PDK#1239/#1260), and the target commit is at/after that point (per the upstream fetch script header).
osdi_toolchain.build_step_needed: yes -- source-build requirement at the target pin (planned; not yet performed or verified). Models the decks actually require must be compiled from Verilog-A source, including the capacitor models (cap_cmomi / cap_cmomf) whose prebuilt objects were removed upstream. The psp103 / r3_cmc / mosvar Verilog-A sources reach ihp-sg13cmos5l/ via relative symlinks into the sibling ihp-sg13g2/ tree (see 'sibling_checkout_requirement'), so the sibling is needed for the build as well.
osdi_toolchain.target_pin_runtime_compatibility: UNVERIFIED. Nothing has been compiled, loaded or simulated at the target pin by this repository. Compiler/ngspice version compatibility, the set of models required, and successful loading must be demonstrated in the permitted backend (deferred, see 'deferred_requirements').
osdi_toolchain.build_script_scope: sim/tools/build-osdi.sh is SG13G2-oriented; its configured model list is psp103, psp103_nqs, r3_cmc, mosvar. It is NOT asserted to cover every CMOS5L model (e.g. the capacitor models). Whether it needs changes for the target pin is undetermined and out of scope here (no tool edits were made).

historical_old_pin_observations._comment: Valid ONLY for the old pin (IHP-GmbH/ihp-sg13cmos5l main @ 607e18d4, observed 2026-08, issue #65). Not evidence about the target pin.
historical_old_pin_observations.old_pin_build_osdi_check: At the old pin, `sim/tools/build-osdi.sh --check` (called by sim/lib/pvt_preflight.sh regardless of $PDK; resolves PDK_ROOT/$PDK via sim/env.sh) found its four REQUIRED_OSDI files already present and loaded them in a real ngspice model-instantiation check, with no script changes (observed 2026-08). That observation says nothing about the cap models or about the target pin.

osdi_toolchain.install_dir: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13cmos5l/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi (PDK-install territory, not tracked in this repo, same convention as sim/pdk.json's SG13G2 entry)

deferred_requirements._comment: Tracked by issue #322 (stays open; the pin/setup documentation update uses 'Refs #322'). None of this is done or claimed by the pin re-stamp.
deferred_requirements.provisioning: The batch tooling/image owner must supply a pinned, checksum-verified CMOS5L subtree at the target commit alongside an identified compatible SG13G2 sibling, compile the models the decks require, and demonstrate loading on the permitted batch backend, recording artifact/image identity, simulator/compiler versions and a successful single-corner job. As observed 2026-10-12, 2AMLogic/2am infra/aws/batch-image-pins.env lists PDK_VARIANTS 'sky130A gf180mcuD ihp-sg13g2' (SG13G2 only); no authorized CMOS5L execution path is claimed. No local-grid exception exists.
deferred_requirements.harness_conversion: The four SG13CMOS5L experiments (core-open-loop-bias, startup-trip-point, closed-loop-startup, closed-loop-startup-pex) still use legacy run_pvt_sweep.sh loops; runners, klt-sim request templates and record specs (reusing sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py, with a separately validated PNP corner mapping) must be created before any new-pin grid.
deferred_requirements.pex_binding: Validity of the startup PEX deck/extraction at the target pin must be established, with extraction and DUT hashes recorded, before new-pin physical evidence is presented.
deferred_requirements.evidence_refresh: Append complete corner grids for the four experiments on the target pin, compare old/new, and keep historical evidence unchanged. Regressions do not authorize retuning or spec changes.

bipolar_device_note._comment: SG13CMOS5L has no npn13G2-equivalent HBT -- only pnpMPA, a low-gain (bf ~= 1.10 nominal, corner-swept via cornerPNP.lib below) parasitic-style PNP. See spec/decision-records/0004-cmos5l-bipolar-device-selection.md (DR-0004).
bipolar_device_note.process_corner_file: libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerPNP.lib (a REAL file in this checkout, not a symlink -- confirmed by direct listing)
bipolar_device_note.no_skewed_pnp_sections: Unlike cornerMOShv.lib (which has mos_sf/mos_fs skew corners), cornerPNP.lib has no sf/fs-equivalent skew section -- same shape as SG13G2's own cornerHBT.lib (hbt_typ/hbt_bcs/hbt_wcs only). This repo's sim/lib/pvt_preflight.sh HBT_SECTION_OF map already falls the sf/fs grid points back to the typ section for exactly this reason; this phase's own sg13cmos5l-*/run_pvt_sweep.sh scripts define an equivalent PNP_SECTION_OF map with the identical sf/fs->typ fallback, kept local to those scripts rather than added to the shared pvt_preflight.sh (SG13G2's testbenches never reference a PNP section at all, so adding it to shared code would be dead weight there).

supply_rails._comment: Per spec/porting-plan-sg13cmos5l.md's own clarification: this repo's bandgap-only block uses ONLY the 3.3V HV-flavor analog rail (sg13_hv_nmos/pmos, identical device+rating to SG13G2's own DR-0002 choice) -- the parent epic's '1.2V digital / 3.3V analog' framing names SG13CMOS5L's LV-flavor DIGITAL rail, which this analog-only block never instantiates a device against. issue #65's PVT sweep therefore uses the SAME {2.97, 3.30, 3.63} V grid (+-10% of 3.3V) as every existing SG13G2 sim/ testbench, not a second 1.2V rail sweep -- there is no 1.2V-rated device anywhere in design/sg13cmos5l/*.sch to sweep.
